summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. filed an 8-K announcing its wholly-owned subsidiary Quantum Drones Corporation entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire substantially all assets of Arcade Technology LLC's precision metal stamping business for $3.2 million total consideration ($900,000 plus inventory value). The transaction is structured as an asset purchase with a ten-day due diligence period and requires simultaneous closing of a separate property acquisition. Closing expected shortly after due diligence, subject to Connecticut tax clearance. Watch for due diligence outcome and regulatory clearance timing.
